summary: Frontend changes add an admin per-user reports drilldown via a URL search param filter on the report history page, plus UI utilities and additional admin tooling. Backend changes show new allowlist-based admin determination logic and admin-gated reset, but the diff is truncated and does not clearly show that allowlisted admins are actually assigned/recognized as admins for the existing admin-only operations (list users/list reports) after signup/login.

missing_requirements.requirement: Fix backend admin authorization so an allowlisted admin account can successfully access admin-only operations (including listing all users and accessing all reports) after signup/login.
missing_requirements.reason: backend/main.mo shows allowlist checks and a determineAccessControlRole helper, but the provided diff does not show where/when AccessControl roles are assigned to the caller after signup/login, nor does it show the admin-only methods for listing users/reports being updated to use this corrected role assignment. Because the backend file is truncated, there is insufficient evidence that allowlisted admins can successfully call the list-users and list-reports operations without unauthorized traps.

missing_requirements.requirement: Ensure the admin reports view supports showing all reports (unfiltered) and filtered-by-user reports with clear, English UI labels indicating the current filter, including an English empty state for no reports for the selected user.
missing_requirements.reason: ReportHistoryPage.tsx clearly applies a userPrincipal filter from URL search params and enforces admin-only access for filtered views, but the truncated excerpt does not show the UI controls/labels for switching between “All reports” and “Reports for <selected user>” (e.g., a clear filter action) or the exact English empty-state text for the per-user no-reports case.
evidence: frontend-file-summaries.txt (ReportHistoryPage description mentions empty states but the actual strings/UI are not visible in the diff excerpt)
